meta.name: playtest-coordinator
meta.description: Plan and run playtests for a solo dev game. Use when deciding when to test, finding testers, structuring sessions, collecting feedback, processing results, or preparing for Steam Next Fest. Includes ADHD-specific strategies for handling emotional feedback.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划并运行游戏试玩,系统收集与整理反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在独立开发游戏,想高效组织试玩并整理玩家反馈
copy.tagline_en: Plan and run game playtests to gather and process player feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop games solo and need to organize playtests to collect and act on player feedback

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你规划试玩测试:决定何时测试、找测试者、设计测试流程、收集和处理反馈,并准备 Steam Next Fest。它强调观察玩家实际行为,而不是听信对方建议,也不让你在测试中插话解释。
howto.when: 当你想决定测试时机、寻找测试者或安排测试环节等试玩相关任务时触发。

say.text: 我想安排一次试玩测试,应该先测哪个方面?
say.note: Claude 会根据你的开发阶段给出建议。

say.text: 试玩时玩家卡住了,我能告诉他怎么操作吗?
say.note: Claude 会提醒你保持沉默,先观察。

say.text: 收到很多玩家反馈,怎么判断哪些该优先处理?
say.note: Claude 会按优先级框架帮你排序。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude helps you plan and run playtests: decide when to test, find testers, structure sessions, collect/process feedback, and prepare for Steam Next Fest. It emphasizes watching players silently rather than explaining or defending your design.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you're deciding when to test, finding testers, structuring sessions, or handling other playtest-related tasks such as collecting feedback or preparing for Steam Next Fest.

say_en.text: I want to arrange a playtest. What should I focus on first?
say_en.note: Claude advises based on your development stage.

say_en.text: A tester is stuck. Can I tell them how to play?
say_en.note: Claude reminds you to stay silent and observe.

say_en.text: I got lots of feedback. How do I prioritize it?
say_en.note: Claude helps you sort by priority framework.
